title: Very Well Done!
body: I love how affordable it is to get Rabit Plus for $40, which last forever! But even when you don’t pay for the Plus, you get a variety of habits, routines, and planners to organize your goals! I can only think of certain suggestions to make this app even better! Maybe an integration of activities to promote a healthy mentality/emotional wellness! These can be simple like looking for specific colored objects in a room, or daily reflection prompts. I would also suggest that there be a widget so we can easily access the app on the lock screen of our phones. I love how simplistic and accessible this app is, because so many other ones require you to pay a premium. Mental health and daily routines should not be restricted by a pay wall!! Thank you for this app <3

title: Horrible Update
body:
I have been using this app for over a year. There has only ever been one issue with it. Whenever you open the app, it freezes for about a minute. Super annoying but I ignored it because I had built up habit streaks that I didn’t want to lose by switching to another app. 

Recently they updated their app to have 
pop-up ads. This wouldn’t be a problem if they appeared at reasonable times but the ads appear every 30ish seconds. They don’t even let you finish what you were doing before displaying the ad. 

They had a good app that they could build off of, but with the freezing and constant ads, it’s just not a good app anymore. 

Don’t waste your time. There are better habit apps out there.
